review_candidates.description: Do you get energised by keeping a secure Microsoft cloud platform running well, from identity and endpoints to the servers behind it? Do you have a background in Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune and Azure, and do you like taking real responsibility for a platform rather than only working tickets? Who is Xsens Xsens is a leading full-stack provider of sensors, software, and analytics that enable the digitization of movement. Xsens serves the entertainment, humanoid robotics, health & sports and automation & mobility markets. We collaborate with leading global innovators including Boston Dynamics, Toyota, Siemens, Electronic Arts, Epic Games, Netflix and 20th Century Studios, alongside more than 1,000 research institutions, humanoid robotics companies and universities worldwide. Your role as a Cloud System Engineer at Xsens We are looking for a Cloud System Engineer to look after our Microsoft cloud and server platform: Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Intune, Azure and the Windows servers that run our business. You keep the platform secure, current and documented. You work in a small in-house IT team with contracted partners for Microsoft managed services and 24/7 security monitoring. You report to the IT Manager and work closely with our infrastructure lead on design and larger changes. You pick up escalations from our servicedesk and are the first technical contact for our partners. Much of the platform is already documented, monitored and automated, so you spend your time on real work instead of finding out how things are set up. This position is based in Enschede, the Netherlands; colleagues work from Enschede, Los Angeles and remote locations worldwide. What makes this role different AI is part of the daily work. Our IT team uses AI assistants for real operations work: troubleshooting, automation, documentation and changes. You learn to work this way from day one. A setup worth getting to know. Azure next to our own virtualisation platform, offices on three continents, a network we run ourselves, and monitoring and automation we built in-house. There is always a next challenge. Colleagues who care about technology. Xsens builds sensors and software for motion capture and robotics, so the people you support are engineers and researchers who understand technology and like to think along. One environment, not a stream of client projects. We are not a managed services provider. You get to know one platform in depth and you see the results of your own improvements. The work itself varies a lot from week to week. Key challenges: Servers and Azure: keep our Windows servers and Azure virtual machines patched, monitored and backed up, including restore tests, together with our Microsoft managed services partner. Security: follow up on alerts with our 24/7 security monitoring partner and carry out recurring checks such as access reviews and vulnerability follow-up. Identity and access: Entra ID and Active Directory: accounts, groups, licences, authentication methods and the automated joiner, mover and leaver flow from our HR system. Improvement and documentation: take part in migrations and clean-ups, automate recurring work with PowerShell, and keep the runbooks and documentation current. Microsoft 365: this is largely your own domain. You run Exchange Online, SharePoint and Teams, keep them secure and decide how we can use them better. Endpoints: manage our laptops and phones in Intune, including Autopilot, compliance, app deployment and Apple devices. Room to grow: once you have found your feet, there is plenty more to get into if it interests you: our network (firewalls, switching, Wi-Fi) across offices worldwide, our Linux servers, our own virtualisation platform, monitoring and automation. We teach you along the way. Balance: roughly 60% operations and security, 40% improvement projects. Xsens is looking for a Cloud System Engineer who thinks in controls, not tickets: you want to know why something is configured the way it is, you fix the cause rather than the symptom, and you write it down. You take ownership of your part of the platform, you enjoy working in a small team where you can learn from experienced colleagues, and you can explain a risk to a manager as easily as to an auditor. You have: 3+ years in a system or cloud engineering role in a Microsoft environment. Hands-on Entra ID and Microsoft 365 administration: Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and working knowledge of Conditional Access. Experience with Intune and Autopilot. Windows Server administration: Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy, patching, backup and restore. Azure experience: virtual machines, networking, backup and update management. PowerShell; you automate what you do twice. A security mindset: you want what you build to be secure, and you stay practical about it so the work still gets done. You diagnose problems yourself before you escalate, and you write down what you did so the next person can follow it. Strong communication skills in English; Dutch is a plus. Nice to have: Privileged Identity Management, Defender XDR, Log Analytics or Sentinel. Familiarity with NIS2 or ISO 27001 style controls. Networking (firewalls, VPN, VLANs, ideally FortiGate) and Linux basics. No background in these? No problem: we teach you the basics using our own runbooks. Certifications are a plus, for example Microsoft (MD-102, MS-102, AZ-104), ITIL Foundation, Fortinet NSE 4, CCNA or LPIC-1. Hands-on experience counts for more than certificates. Experience using AI assistants in your daily IT work, or the curiosity to learn it: our team uses them heavily. Working at Xsens We value ingenious ideas, no matter where they come from. We believe diverse thoughts, voices, and backgrounds make us stronger as a company. We know that it is through collaboration with people from all walks of life that we make the most positive impact as an organization. Join Xsens’ innovative, ambitious, and international team, where your ideas and talents make an impact. Along with a competitive compensation package, we offer a range of benefits designed to support your well-being and help you thrive. 28 paid vacation days with an option to buy, sell, or carry over days, giving you flexibility to manage your time off as appropriate to your situation Tax perks for your sports memberships and bicycle purchase; so staying active is easier than ever. Enjoy company social events as well as fun, informal activities organized by our staff association. From movie nights and sports clinics to cooking classes and LAN parties, there’s always something happening to connect and have fun

review_candidates.description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요 토스증권의 Network Security Engineer는 Network Engineer, IDC Manager와 함께 Network Engineering Team에 소속되어 있어요. 대고객 및 내부고객 전반에 대한 보안 네트워크 구축 및 지원을 위해 금융, 커머스, 포털, 게임사 등 여러 분야에서 모인 인프라, 개발 영역의 우수한 인재들과 협업하고 있어요. '제품에만 집중할 수 있도록 모든 것을 지원한다'라는 목표를 두고, 리테일 1위 증권사 규모의 용량을 지원할 수 있는 인프라 구축을 위해 노력하고 있어요. 더욱 빠른 제품 출시를 위해 자동화도 추진하고 있어요. 합류하면 함께 할 업무예요 온프레미스 및 클라우드 환경의 네트워크 보안 인프라를 구축하고 운영해요. VPC 설계, 인라인 트래픽 검사, 네트워크 세그멘테이션 등 보안 아키텍처의 설계와 구현에 참여해요. 대규모 트래픽이 흐르는 서비스망에서 Fortinet 등 글로벌 보안 장비 기반의 방화벽, VPN, DDoS 방어 장비, NPB 등을 운영하며, 모니터링과 장애 대응, 정책 변경을 통해 서비스 안정성을 높여요. API, Python, Terraform, Ansible 등을 활용해 방화벽 정책의 검증·배포·변경·폐기 과정과 반복적인 운영 업무를 자동화해요. 금융 분야 정보보호 요구사항에 따른 망 분리·접근 통제 정책을 적용하고, 운영 이력과 증적을 체계적으로 관리해요. AI 서비스와 GPU 워크로드의 통신을 파악해 트래픽 가시성과 보안 통제를 개선하고, AI 도구를 활용해 로그 분석과 정책 검토, 변경 영향 분석의 효율과 정확도를 높여요. 이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요 대규모 트래픽에 최적화된 보안 네트워크 아키텍처를 설계하고 구축한 경험이 필요해요. 방화벽 정책 분석, 최적화 및 유지 관리 업무를 수행한 경험이 필요해요. TCP/IP 프로토콜 이해도가 높고, 트러블슈팅을 위한 패킷 분석 경험이 필요해요. 네트워크 보안 장비의 API 연동이나 Script(Python 등) 작성으로 업무를 자동화하거나, 내부 운영 도구를 직접 개발한 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요. IaC(Terraform, Ansible)로 네트워크·보안 정책을 형상 관리하고, 파이프라인에서 정책을 검증해본 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요. 클라우드에서 인라인 보안 검사 구조(GWLB/Network Firewall, NVA, 서비스 체이닝)를 설계·구축해본 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요. 컨테이너 환경(EKS, GKE)의 네트워크와 세그멘테이션(NetworkPolicy 등)을 이해하고 있다면 더욱 좋아요. Flow Log, 패킷 브로커, SSL 복호화 기반 분석 등으로 트래픽 가시성을 확보해본 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요. AI/LLM을 활용해 보안 운영을 자동화해봤거나, AI 워크로드의 네트워크 통제를 고민해본 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요. 금융정보 보호 관련 규정을 이해하고, 관련 구축 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요. 이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요 기술적인 문제 개선 (최적화, 오류 수정 등) 사례 중 가장 기억에 남는 것을 기술해 주세요. 기여한 프로젝트를 사례 중심으로 상세하게 기술해 주세요. (본인의 역할, 본인이 사용했던 기술스택, 프로젝트 전후 개선된 점 등) 토스증권으로의 합류여정 서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종 합격 및 입사 꼭 확인해 주세요 이력서 및 제출 서류에 허위 사실이 발견되거나 근무 이력 중 징계사항이 확인될 경우, 채용이 취소될 수 있어요. 토스증권 내규에 따라 채용금지자 또는 결격사유 해당자는 채용이 취소될 수 있어요. 장애인 및 국가보훈대상자는 지원 시 관련법에 따라 우대하고 있어요. 함께할 동료를 위한 한마디 "토스증권 Infra팀에서는 저와 팀이 함께 성장하고 있음을 매번 느끼며 일할 수 있어요" 저는 방화벽 엔지니어로 운영을 경험해 오다가 토스팀에 합류하게 되었고, 현재는 고객과 팀을 보호하기 위한 네트워크 보안 장비를 구성하고 운영하며 안전한 네트워크를 만들기위해 노력하고 있어요. 기존의 수직적인 금융권의 특성상 폐쇄적인 네트워크 환경에서 제한된 업무를 수행해왔지만, 토스증권 Network Security Engineer로써는 다양한 보안 장비와 솔루션에 대한 경험을 할 기회가 있습니다. 그리고 팀과 고객에게 원활한 서비스 환경을 제공하기 위해 고민하고 실행하며 개인과 팀의 성장이 함께 이루어지는 것도 체감하실 수 있어요!
